title: DR-17: previous-epoch ratchet_tree_presence not checked
description: mls-ratchet-tree-options-01 §4 PartialGroupInfo carries ratchet_tree_presence covering the previous epoch too. That half is not covered by the GroupInfo signature and is not needed to rebuild it; checking it would require per-epoch history in the Observer. Chosen: Observer::group_info checks only the half it uses; documented in # Limitations.
